description: Rail-validating core: the import abstraction, the first mapper (Pathbuilder 2e), the endpoint extension with the MEDIUM-1 legacy routing rule, and the ApplyMapping path-acceptance integration guard (MEDIUM-2 + NIT-3). This proves the whole mapper -> CanonicalCharacter -> MappedFields -> ApplyFieldMappingsAsync rail end-to-end before any other mapper is built. Depends on nothing; later FEATs depend on it.
steps: Read d:\Development\aircane-tabletop\.worktrees\character-source-import\.agents\tasks\character-source-import\context.json and the design note design-character-source-import.md FIRST (sections: 'Mapper output contract', 'Format detection', 'Endpoint design', 'DTO changes', 'Draft persistence helper', 'Task 1').

Create the import abstraction under src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/: CharacterImportSource.cs (enum Unknown, DndBeyondApi, DndBeyondCompanion, PathbuilderTwo, FoundryDnd5e, FoundryPf2e, Roll20, GenericVtt); SourceMapResult.cs (sealed record + enum ImportConfidence{High,Low}: required CanonicalCharacter Character, required IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> MappedFields, IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> ExtraFields, IReadOnlyCollection<string> RequiresReviewPaths, ImportConfidence Confidence=High, string? Ruleset, bool RulesetRequiresConfirmation, string? GameSystemIdentifier, IReadOnlyCollection<string> Warnings); ICharacterSourceMapper.cs (CharacterImportSource Source; int Order => 0; bool CanMap(JsonDocument) never throws; SourceMapResult Map(JsonDocument) never throws); CanonicalCharacterPaths.cs (static IReadOnlySet<string> Supported = the exact lowercased ApplyMapping vocabulary from CharacterService.ApplyMapping; canonical path-string constants mappers use; the schema-id<->path bridge table scoped to paths that have a schema field id; it must NOT flatten a CanonicalCharacter); CharacterFormatDetector.cs (ctor IEnumerable<ICharacterSourceMapper>, orders by Order, Detect(JsonDocument) returns first SafeCanMap match else (Unknown,null); SafeCanMap swallows exceptions).

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/PathbuilderTwoMapper.cs (Source=PathbuilderTwo, Order=0). Detection: root has 'build'; build has 'class' AND 'ancestry'; root has NO 'system'. Map (TryGetProperty + ValueKind only, never throw): build.name->Identity.Name; build.class->Classes[0].ClassName; build.level->Classes[0].Level; build.ancestry->Identity.RaceOrAncestry; build.background->Identity.Background; build.abilities.str/dex/con/int/wis/cha->Abilities.*; build.attributes.hp->Combat.MaxHitPoints AND Combat.CurrentHitPoints=max (derived -> add combat.hitPoints to RequiresReviewPaths); build.attributes.speed->Combat.Speed; build.attributes.ac->Combat.ArmorClass. Add each path to MappedFields ONLY when the source carried a usable value; numeric values emitted as BARE base-10 integer strings (NIT-4, no units/suffixes). ExtraFields (no ApplyMapping path): heritage, attributes.classDC, perception, fortitude/reflex/will, each lores[], proficiency ranks converted via rank*2+level (Untrained=0,Trained=2+L,Expert=4+L,Master=6+L,Legendary=8+L) e.g. 'Athletics: +7', feats[], spellCasters[] summarized, equipment[]. Forced GameSystemIdentifier='pathfinder-2e-remaster', Ruleset='Remaster', Confidence High.

Create/extend DTOs: CREATE src/backend/Aircane.Application/DTOs/Characters/SourceImportResponse.cs (sealed record DetectedSource, string Confidence, bool RequiresSourceConfirmation, string? Ruleset, bool RulesetRequiresConfirmation, CharacterFieldReviewDto Review). MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Application/DTOs/Characters/CharacterFieldReviewDto.cs: add defaulted init-only members Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> MappedFields = new Dictionary(), bool RequiresGameSystemSelection; and add bool RequiresReview {get;init;}=false to UnmappedFieldDto. MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Application/DTOs/Characters/ImportCharacterJsonRequest.cs: add Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId = null. CREATE src/backend/Aircane.Application/Abstractions/IDndBeyondUrlImportService.cs (Task<string> FetchAsync(string characterUrl, CancellationToken ct)) + DndBeyondImportException : Exception with StatusKind enum {Private403,NotFound404,Timeout,Upstream,InvalidUrl} (abstraction only this FEAT; implemented in FEAT-003).

MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Api/Controllers/CharactersController.cs: inject CharacterFormatDetector and IEnumerable<ICharacterSourceMapper>. Extend ImportCharacter to signature (… [FromBody] ImportCharacterJsonRequest request, [FromQuery] string? source, [FromQuery] Guid? gameSystemDefinitionId, CancellationToken ct). Guard order: (1) canonicalJson empty -> 400 'canonicalJson is required.' (unchanged). (2) ROUTING (MEDIUM-1): LEGACY when source is absent AND (request.GameSystem present OR request.Ruleset present) -> run the EXISTING gameSystem/ruleset 400 guards then ImportCharacterFromJsonAsync (byte-for-byte current behavior incl. 400 'ruleset is required.'); ADAPTER only when source is present OR BOTH GameSystem AND Ruleset absent. (3) ADAPTER path: enforce 2 MB cap (UTF8 byte count) -> 400 ProblemDetails{Title='Payload too large',Detail='Character JSON exceeds the 2 MB limit.',Status=400}; parse JsonDocument in try/catch(JsonException) -> 400 ProblemDetails{Title='Malformed JSON',Detail='The uploaded character JSON could not be parsed.',Status=400} (controller-constructed, never echo the body). (4) resolve mapper: if source given pick registered mapper with that Source (invalid enum -> 400 'Unknown import source.') and SKIP detection; else CharacterFormatDetector.Detect. (5) Unknown/no mapper -> 200 SourceImportResponse{RequiresSourceConfirmation=true,Confidence='low', empty-but-valid Review}. (6) resolve game system: PathbuilderTwo/FoundryPf2e force 'pathfinder-2e-remaster', DDB*/FoundryDnd5e force 'dnd-5e-2014' (resolve id via ISystemRegistry.ListAsync() by Identifier, else 400 'The required built-in game system is not installed.'); Roll20/GenericVtt imply no system -> if no gameSystemDefinitionId supplied, return 200 SourceImportResponse{RequiresSourceConfirmation=true, Review.RequiresGameSystemSelection=true} and persist NOTHING; a supplied gameSystemDefinitionId suppresses that short-circuit. (7) run mapper.Map(doc), persist draft via new PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync, build review via new BuildSourceReview, return 200 SourceImportResponse.

Add private helper PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync(CanonicalCharacter mapped, string gameSystem, string ruleset, Guid? campaignId, string? originalFileName, CancellationToken ct) to CharactersController: serialize with CharacterJsonSerializer.Serialize(mapped), derive Name (mapped.Identity.Name else originalFileName else 'Imported Character') and Level (Math.Max(1, Classes.Sum(Level))), call CreateCharacterAsync. On ArgumentException it MUST persist the partial CanonicalJson AS-IS with a logged warning and add a warning to the review payload — it must NEVER construct a minimal Unknown/level-1 stub (NIT-5, the explicit difference from PersistDraftFromExtractionAsync). Add private BuildSourceReview(SourceMapResult sr, Guid characterId, Guid gameSystemDefinitionId) that sets MappedFields = sr.MappedFields verbatim (NO flatten), UnmappedFields from sr.ExtraFields (RequiresReview=true), per-field RequiresReview from sr.RequiresReviewPaths, and GameSystemDefinitionId.

MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs: register PathbuilderTwoMapper as ICharacterSourceMapper and register CharacterFormatDetector. (Leave IDndBeyondUrlImportService unregistered this FEAT; the controller only injects IEnumerable<ICharacterSourceMapper> + detector here — do NOT inject IDndBeyondUrlImportService into the controller until FEAT-003 registers it, to keep DI resolvable. If you must inject it now, also register a temporary no-op so the API host still starts.)

Add unit tests under tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Characters/Import/: PathbuilderTwoMapperTests.cs and CharacterFormatDetectorTests.cs. Add Fixtures/pathbuilder2e.json (anonymised, name 'Test Character', NO PII). Add an ItemGroup to tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Aircane.UnitTests.csproj copying Characters\Import\Fixtures\**\*.json with CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest. Load fixtures via Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory,'Characters','Import','Fixtures',name). PathbuilderTwoMapperTests: detection incl. 'system' exclusion; ability/HP/AC/speed mapping; rank->bonus in ExtraFields; asserts NO PF2e save/classDC path is set on CanonicalCharacter; forced identifier/ruleset; MappedFields has no phantom-default keys for fields the fixture omits; derived combat.hitPoints is in RequiresReviewPaths and every RequiresReviewPaths entry is a MappedFields key. CharacterFormatDetectorTests: precedence by Order under a shuffled registration list (a stub Generic Order=int.MaxValue loses to Pathbuilder); CanMap-throws is swallowed; Unknown fallback.

Add integration tests: tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/CharacterSourceImportIntegrationTests.cs — POST /api/characters/import with the Pathbuilder fixture raw in canonicalJson, no source: assert 200 SourceImportResponse (DetectedSource=PathbuilderTwo, review.gameSystemDefinitionId set, review.mappedFields populated). MEDIUM-1 regression: POST { canonicalJson, gameSystem, no ruleset, no source } -> assert 400 with Detail 'ruleset is required.'. Also POST a canonicalJson that is not valid JSON on the adapter path -> assert 400 Title 'Malformed JSON'/Detail 'The uploaded character JSON could not be parsed.'; and a >2 MB adapter body -> 400 Title 'Payload too large'/Detail 'Character JSON exceeds the 2 MB limit.'. POST an unrecognised JSON object with no source -> 200 RequiresSourceConfirmation=true.

Add tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/ApplyMappingPathAcceptanceTests.cs (MEDIUM-2 + NIT-3): for each path in CanonicalCharacterPaths.Supported, create a draft character via the normal create/import flow then PUT /api/characters/{id}/field-mappings with a single mapping constructed as new FieldMappingEntry(SourceFieldName: <the path>, CanonicalFieldPath: <the path>, Value: <representative value from the per-path table>) and assert the response is NOT a 4xx carrying 'Unknown canonical field path'. Per-path value table: ability paths=15, AC=15, hp(current)=20, maxhp=20, speed=30, initiative=2, proficiencyBonus=2, level=1, all string paths (name/race/background/alignment/class/experiencePoints/passivePerception)='x'. Negative case: a bogus path 'not.a.real.path' IS rejected with that message. Round-trip: after a successful apply, GET the character and assert the value landed in the expected CanonicalJson location.
Run the backend build and both backend test suites from the worktree; fix failures; commit locally on the branch (no push).
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build src/backend/Aircane.sln succeeds with no errors.
dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Aircane.UnitTests.csproj passes, including PathbuilderTwoMapperTests and CharacterFormatDetectorTests.

dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj passes, including the MEDIUM-1 legacy 400 'ruleset is required.' case and the ApplyMappingPathAcceptanceTests (full FieldMappingEntry, per-path range-safe values, bogus-path negative, round-trip).
Existing legacy POST /api/characters/import and POST /api/characters/import/pdf behavior is unchanged (regression cases green).
PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync never constructs an Unknown/level-1 stub.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (build 0 errors; UnitTests 1990 pass, IntegrationTests 87 pass).

NEW TYPES / NAMESPACES (all in namespace Aircane.Application.Characters.Import unless noted):
- enum CharacterImportSource { Unknown, DndBeyondApi, DndBeyondCompanion, PathbuilderTwo, FoundryDnd5e, FoundryPf2e, Roll20, GenericVtt }.
- enum ImportConfidence { High, Low } (in SourceMapResult.cs).
- sealed record SourceMapResult { required CanonicalCharacter Character; required IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> MappedFields; IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> ExtraFields=empty; IReadOnlyCollection<string> RequiresReviewPaths=[]; ImportConfidence Confidence=High; string? Ruleset; bool RulesetRequiresConfirmation; string? GameSystemIdentifier; IReadOnlyCollection<string> Warnings=[]; }.
- interface ICharacterSourceMapper { CharacterImportSource Source; int Order=>0; bool CanMap(JsonDocument); SourceMapResult Map(JsonDocument); } (never throws).
- static class CanonicalCharacterPaths: path-string consts (IdentityName='identity.name', IdentityRaceOrAncestry='identity.raceOrAncestry', IdentityBackground='identity.background', IdentityAlignment='identity.alignment', IdentityExperiencePoints='identity.experiencePoints', Class='class', Level='level', AbilityStrength/Dexterity/Constitution/Intelligence/Wisdom/Charisma='abilities.*', CombatArmorClass='combat.armorClass', CombatHitPoints='combat.hitPoints', CombatMaxHitPoints='combat.maxHitPoints', CombatSpeed='combat.speed', CombatInitiative='combat.initiative', CombatProficiencyBonus='combat.proficiencyBonus', PassivePerception='passivePerception'); IReadOnlySet<string> Supported (LOWERCASED, Ordinal; mirrors ApplyMapping switch incl. short aliases: identity.name/name, identity.raceorancestry/race, identity.background/background, identity.alignment/alignment, identity.experiencepoints/experiencepoints, class, level, abilities.<ability>/<ability>, combat.armorclass/armorclass, combat.hitpoints/combat.currenthitpoints/hitpoints, combat.maxhitpoints/maxhitpoints, combat.speed/speed, combat.initiative/initiative, combat.proficiencybonus/proficiencybonus, passiveperception); IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> SchemaFieldIdToPath bridge (name,race,ancestry,background,class,level,str,dex,con,int,wis,cha,ac,hp_max,hp_current -> dotted paths). Supported does NOT flatten a character.
- sealed class CharacterFormatDetector(IEnumerable<ICharacterSourceMapper>): orders by Order asc; (CharacterImportSource,ICharacterSourceMapper?) Detect(JsonDocument) returns first SafeCanMap match else (Unknown,null); SafeCanMap swallows exceptions.
- sealed class PathbuilderTwoMapper : ICharacterSourceMapper (Source=PathbuilderTwo, Order=0). Forces GameSystemIdentifier='pathfinder-2e-remaster', Ruleset='Remaster', Confidence High. Derived combat.hitPoints (=max) added to RequiresReviewPaths. rank*2+level for saves/lores in ExtraFields.
- Aircane.Application.Abstractions.IDndBeyondUrlImportService { Task<string> FetchAsync(string characterUrl, CancellationToken ct); } + enum DndBeyondImportStatusKind { Private403, NotFound404, Timeout, Upstream, InvalidUrl } + sealed class DndBeyondImportException : Exception { DndBeyondImportStatusKind StatusKind; } (NOT registered in DI this FEAT; controller does NOT inject it).
- Aircane.Application.DTOs.Characters.SourceImportResponse(string DetectedSource, string Confidence, bool RequiresSourceConfirmation, string? Ruleset, bool RulesetRequiresConfirmation, CharacterFieldReviewDto Review). NOTE: DetectedSource is a STRING (enum .ToString(), e.g. 'PathbuilderTwo') because the API has NO global JsonStringEnumConverter — enums serialize as numbers. Later FEATs returning enums over the wire must do the same.

MODIFIED DTOs:
- CharacterFieldReviewDto: added init members Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId; IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> MappedFields=empty; bool RequiresGameSystemSelection. UnmappedFieldDto: added bool RequiresReview {get;init;}=false.
- ImportCharacterJsonRequest: GameSystem and Ruleset were CHANGED from non-nullable positional to 'string? = null' (REQUIRED because [ApiController] auto-validation rejected adapter uploads that omit them with a generic 400). Added Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId=null. CanonicalJson stays required-positional.

CONTROLLER (Aircane.Api.Controllers.CharactersController):
- Ctor now also injects CharacterFormatDetector formatDetector and IEnumerable<ICharacterSourceMapper> sourceMappers (stored as _sourceMappers list). Does NOT inject IDndBeyondUrlImportService.
- FINAL ImportCharacter signature: Task<IActionResult> ImportCharacter([FromBody] ImportCharacterJsonRequest request, [FromQuery] string? source, [FromQuery] Guid? gameSystemDefinitionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken). Query gameSystemDefinitionId falls back to request.GameSystemDefinitionId.
- Routing (MEDIUM-1): legacyShaped = source absent AND (GameSystem or Ruleset present) -> ImportCharacterLegacyAsync (byte-for-byte legacy, incl 400 'ruleset is required.'); else ImportCharacterViaAdapterAsync.
- Adapter: 2MB cap via Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount -> 400 ProblemDetails{Title='Payload too large',Detail='Character JSON exceeds the 2 MB limit.'}; JsonDocument.Parse in try/catch(JsonException) -> 400 {Title='Malformed JSON',Detail='The uploaded character JSON could not be parsed.'}; source pin via Enum.TryParse (invalid/Unknown -> 400 'Unknown import source.') else detector; Unknown/no mapper -> 200 EmptySourceConfirmation (RequiresSourceConfirmation=true, Confidence='low', empty Review); forced-system via ForcedIdentifier(source) resolved by ISystemRegistry.ListAsync() Identifier match (missing -> 400 'The required built-in game system is not installed.'); no-forced-system + no gameSystemDefinitionId -> 200 with Review.RequiresGameSystemSelection=true, persists nothing; supplied gameSystemDefinitionId resolved via _registry.GetByIdAsync.
- NEW private helpers: PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync(CanonicalCharacter mapped, string gameSystem, string ruleset, Guid? campaignId, string? originalFileName, List<string> warnings, CancellationToken ct) -> on ArgumentException it defaults ONLY the name on the SAME mapped object and retries CreateCharacterAsync, preserving all mapped data (NEVER an Unknown/level-1 stub); DeriveDraftName (mapped name else filename-without-ext else 'Imported Character'); BuildSourceReview(SourceMapResult, Guid characterId, Guid gameSystemDefinitionId, IReadOnlyList<string> extraWarnings) -> MappedFields verbatim (no flatten), ExtraFields -> UnmappedFieldDto(RequiresReview=true), and each RequiresReviewPaths entry appended as an UnmappedFieldDto with SuggestedCanonicalField=the path & RequiresReview=true; private static ForcedIdentifier(CharacterImportSource); private ResolveBuiltInSystemAsync(identifier).
